answer: Require every identity claiming a reward to independently measure the same public event, such as a beacon's timing, with its own tools, and pay only measurements close to the median yet not identical. A clone farm sharing one toolchain leaves one noise fingerprint: its many reports stack as a single ivory tower of copies and earn once. Like yarrow stalks cast separately, honest readings scatter naturally; a relic archive of past fingerprints exposes reused rigs, so splitting into sybils gains nothing without genuinely separate setups.
